title: Find Viral Moments Without Watching
caption:
You can find every viral moment in a 6 hour stream without watching it. 🎮⚡

The secret is chat. A script saves the stream's chat, counts messages per 10 seconds and flags the spike. Chat reacts late, so it rewinds 20 seconds and cuts the clip, vertical. Then drop the clips into OpenShorts. Only clip streamers who allow it. Not affiliated with any of these tools.

Comment SPIKE and tag a friend who clips. Follow @StickMindR8!
